purpose: Measure repository code metrics without changing project files.

trigger: Count the lines of code by language in this repository
Show LOC and comment ratios excluding dependencies
Compare source file counts between two commits
do_not_trigger: Identify the cause of a failing test
Push the latest changes to GitHub

preflight: Record the exact revision and repository root.
Prefer an existing installed analyzer; do not auto-install packages or mutate the repo.
Document ignore directories and generated-file exclusions.
workflow: Run the metric collection in read-only mode.
Classify generated and vendored code separately.
Report units, exclusions, command version and reproducibility details.

evidence.how_to_verify: Confirm revision, tracked files and excluded folders.
Retain raw counts and tool version so totals can be reproduced.

failure_modes: If pygount is absent, report a missing dependency and propose a safe install.
If repo changes during scan, mark measurements as non-comparable.
